title: ADR-0150: the _env qualifier admits a name held only by disabled packages (404, not 409) on the item face (#32183 row 17, R4-B2)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyrFFk86Jqf7Mp5Rzw

Parent: #32670 (its `_env` half). Filed by area E2 under the seat's routing ruling (2026-11-14T18:12Z, option A). Area-lease pilot #33059, lease:E1.

Blocked-by: #32354

## Premise

#32670 (PR #33361) makes the email template send judge the served holders. The `_env` cell of #32183's row 17 (ruling R4-B2 on PR #32497) is the other half: a name held only by disabled packages answers `409` naming them at the `_env` qualifier, where row 17 says `404` once a disabled package holds no name. The change lives entirely in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/**` (area E1) and depends on #32354's served-holder list, so it is its own card.

## Fix shape

- `admitEnvironmentQualifier` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`) admits `_env` when the name's only holder(s) are disabled.
- Carry the `_env` mark to the item face: `disabledOnlyHolderOf` in `protocol-meta-item-face.ts`, through `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` and `packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.ts` (both transports).
- Never serve a disabled package's pair row.

## Acceptance

- Row 17's `_env` cell moves FROM `409` naming the disabled holders TO `404`, declared FROM→TO with its Clause-② arm and pinned on both transports.
- CONTROLs: an enabled holder (unchanged), a name with no holder (unchanged), and a disabled holder's pair row (never served).
- #32670 closes when this lands.
